P1.evidence: Setter notes referenced but not read back — 'already got some information from Derek, but I would just love to go through where you're at.' Two-part frame with the fit promise attached, missing what's-in-the-way and what-you-need. Agreement asked and given. Open question ran: 'take me through Chad, what can we potentially help you out with?' Credit for one thing not in the script: he checked the time budget up front — 'usually these meetings run for like 45 minutes, sometimes up to an hour. Are you good for that at the moment?' — which was well judged given the prospect had stepped out of a work meeting.

P2.evidence: The injury work was the best part of the call and among the better examples in the batch: severity scaled, duration asked ('how long has it been there, both of those things?'), cause traced back to landmine squat form, and a clean sweep question — 'outside of the knee and the elbow, nothing else that we should know about, any injuries?' Body fat was asked and a target agreed. Nutrition was thorough including the cheat-food frequency probe that surfaced daily ice cream. Age was asked, though late and only in passing. Missing: height and weight entirely, occupation despite the prospect being at work, health conditions or heredity, days trained per week, sleep and energy.

P3.evidence: The surface layer ran properly, including a 1-10 satisfaction scale with a follow-up — 'what makes it a 6 for you?' — and a clean reflect-back at 00:12:13 checked with 'is that the right picture?' The bridge was asked well: 'so many people I speak to when they're 45 are okay with it because it all comes with age. Why do you feel like I'm not okay with this?' He also pushed for the feeling twice, including offering his own example: 'what's glad for Chad?' The depth simply did not land — the answers stayed functional ('I'm just happy, like, I'm fit now') and the five-year longevity question returned 'I don't know'. Nothing reached family, identity or legacy, and no who-else-does-this-impact question was asked even though a wife and a child are both present in the call.

P4.evidence: Asked whether he had ever had a trainer ('I had like four, five sessions'), and how it went, and correctly probed whether it had solved the pain. The regain was explored — the desserts, the wife's dessert, 'instead of one it'll be two'. But the gap was never named by the prospect: asked what he would need from Trevor, he simply repeated the rep's own list back ('I think the ones you just mentioned'), which is a feature answer rather than a structural one, and the rep did not press. The information-isn't-the-problem move never ran, and it was available — this is a man estimating calories by asking an AI.

P5.evidence: No consequence frame. The nearest approach was a why-now question — 'why is this important for you to do it right now instead of wait after summer?' — which is urgency, not cost of inaction. No two-year or five-year negative projection, no settle question, no why-not, no line in the sand. The prospect had handed over the raw material himself, visceral fat and organ function, and none of it was worked.

P6.evidence: The call ended at 00:25:09 before the commitment check could be reached. The rep was explicitly still inside discovery — 'we're almost there, so if you can let me a few more' — when the prospect terminated.

P11.evidence: No offer was ever presented and no close attempted. The prospect asked for the price three times and never received it.

objection_plays.detail: Script gap with an enablement failure behind it. The prospect asked a direct credibility question — 'what are his qualifications?... does he have any certifications or anything?' — and there is no scripted play for it. The rep answered 'Not 100% sure, actually', then offered volume and the absence of online complaints as a substitute: 'I guess if it wasn't good, then probably you would see it all over the internet. Would you agree with that?' A closer selling a health programme to a prospect with two live injuries should have a sanctioned answer to this, and does not.

Second script gap, and the one that lost the call. This prospect refused the discovery sequence and asked three times for the mechanics and the price so he could decide — 'we have discussed enough about me', 'how does this work?', 'how does the program start?'. The playbook has no path for a buyer who wants to evaluate the product before disclosing himself, and the rep's only available move was to hold the frame and refuse: 'I can tell you it's this price, this is how it works, but then we're also not going to work together.' The prospect ended the call in the next turn.

notes: The injury discovery was genuinely good and the goal scaling was useful, but the call died on a frame collision the script does not cover. When a prospect asks the same structural question three times, continuing to withhold it is no longer discipline. Two concrete actions: give closers a sanctioned answer on Trevor's credentials, and give them permission to state format and price early when a prospect demands it and then return to discovery.
